title: Conditional Irrationality of All Projective Stabilizations of Cubic Threefolds: Point-Class Rank under Quantum Wall Crossing
description: Assuming the marked threshold compatibility hypothesis stated in this paper, X × P^m is irrational for every smooth complex cubic threefold X and every m ≥ 0. The endpoint contrast is unconditional: the paper reconstructs the primitive-sixth block from Cai's matrices, proves Gamma point-row nonvanishing by a Barnes calculation, and shows that multiplication by P^m produces m + 1 copies and preserves detection of the resulting packet while projective space has no primitive-sixth packet. It also proves an exact ambient point-column identity for a simple VGIT wall, exact Gamma point-row transport across an ordinary flop, global support collapse, and a coefficientwise balanced Gamma-ratio reduction. A rank-one derived-intersection theorem identifies the fixed clutching stacks and their perfect obstruction theories along every affine tail between thresholds, making complete neutral tails holonomic with tempered growth. The remaining analytic input is locally finite: at every sign, stability, or zero-mode threshold, an isomorphism of finite cyclic Rees z-differential modules must intertwine formal monodromy, carry the marked point row, and preserve the stated Stokes, deck, nearby-cycle, Artin, and Rees data. A rational two-tail counterexample and the other countermodels explain why tailwise holonomicity, formal monodromy, pairing, integrality, and localized Fourier support do not replace that marked compatibility.
